nodes.name: Meses de la ventana
nodes.notes: Ej: 2025-10-01 -> 2026-10-01 produce 12 items, uno por mes. Ventanas parciales quedan recortadas (half-open).

nodes.name: Loop Over Items
nodes.notes: 1 mes por iteracion. Output 'loop' alimenta la cadena; el ultimo nodo (log) vuelve a conectar aqui para la siguiente iteracion. Output 'done' no se usa: el resumen se verifica en ops.pipeline_runs.

nodes.name: Socrata: fetch mes
nodes.notes: 1 pagina por mes: el maximo historico de Chicago es ~45k registros/mes < 50k (pageSize). Si un mes devolviera pageSize registros, el nodo siguiente lo marca FAILED sin insertar (posible truncamiento). OJO: si un mes devolviera 0 items la cadena se detiene en silencio (n8n no ejecuta nodos sin input); no ocurre en este dataset.

nodes.name: Validar + SQL payload (mes)
nodes.notes: Skill chicago-data-ingestion: rechazos (sin id/date) van al log via records_failed, no rompen el run. Un mes truncado queda FAILED y no inserta.

nodes.name: raw.crimes upsert (bulk)

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO raw.crimes (
  id, case_number, date, block, iucr, primary_type, description,
  location_description, arrest, domestic, beat, district, ward,
  community_area, fbi_code, x_coordinate, y_coordinate, year,
  updated_on, latitude, longitude, location
)
SELECT
  r.id,
  r.case_number,
  nullif(r.date::text, '')::timestamp,
  r.block,
  r.iucr,
  r.primary_type,
  r.description,
  r.location_description,
  nullif(r.arrest::text, '')::boolean,
  nullif(r.domestic::text, '')::boolean,
  nullif(r.beat::text, '')::integer,
  nullif(r.district::text, '')::integer,
  nullif(r.ward::text, '')::integer,
  nullif(r.community_area::text, '')::integer,
  r.fbi_code,
  nullif(r.x_coordinate::text, '')::double precision,
  nullif(r.y_coordinate::text, '')::double precision,
  nullif(r.year::text, '')::integer,
  nullif(r.updated_on::text, '')::timestamp,
  nullif(r.latitude::text, '')::double precision,
  nullif(r.longitude::text, '')::double precision,
  r.location
FROM jsonb_to_recordset({{ $json.payloadSql }}::jsonb) AS r (
  id text, case_number text, date text, block text, iucr text,
  primary_type text, description text, location_description text,
  arrest text, domestic text, beat text, district text, ward text,
  community_area text, fbi_code text,
  x_coordinate text, y_coordinate text, year text, updated_on text,
  latitude text, longitude text, location jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  case_number = EXCLUDED.case_number,
  date = EXCLUDED.date,
  block = EXCLUDED.block,
  iucr = EXCLUDED.iucr,
  primary_type = EXCLUDED.primary_type,
  description = EXCLUDED.description,
  location_description = EXCLUDED.location_description,
  arrest = EXCLUDED.arrest,
  domestic = EXCLUDED.domestic,
  beat = EXCLUDED.beat,
  district = EXCLUDED.district,
  ward = EXCLUDED.ward,
  community_area = EXCLUDED.community_area,
  fbi_code = EXCLUDED.fbi_code,
  x_coordinate = EXCLUDED.x_coordinate,
  y_coordinate = EXCLUDED.y_coordinate,
  year = EXCLUDED.year,
  updated_on = EXCLUDED.updated_on,
  latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude,
  longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude,
  location = EXCLUDED.location,
  loaded_at = now();

nodes.notes: UPSERT por id (regla: re-ingesta tolerante a correcciones de Socrata). Sin cambios desde el Paso 2: si el mes viene truncado el payload llega vacio ('[]') y este INSERT no afecta filas.

nodes.name: log run en pipeline_runs

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO ops.pipeline_runs (
  workflow_name, finished_at, status, window_start, window_end,
  records_received, records_failed, error_message
)
VALUES (
  'sprint2-socrata-raw',
  now(),
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  '{{ $json.windowStart }}'::timestamp,
  '{{ $json.windowEnd }}'::timestamp,
  {{ $json.received }},
  {{ $json.failed }},
  nullif('{{ $json.errorMessage }}', '')
);

nodes.notes: 1 fila por mes procesado (observabilidad del backfill). records_inserted/updated: NULL en este MVP (se refina en Sprint 10).

meta.notes: Sprint 2 Paso 3: bucle por ventanas mensuales (1 año = 12 iteraciones). Credential postgres a reasignar tras importar: host=postgres (red docker), port=5432, db=chicago_crimes, user/pass del .env. Cambios vs Paso 2: la validacion se mueve al Code node (conteos por iteracion) y el log registra 1 fila por mes con error_message.
